data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'w-h-b', meaning 'to give' or 'gift'. In Islamic tradition, Mawhiba signifies a person who is blessed and gifted by Allah. The name Mawhiba carries the meaning “Gifted, Blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mawhiba usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted, blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
